case: sleep / resume and PID or lease replacement

scenarios.name: mac sleeps 3 h, heartbeat is old, owner alive
scenarios.expect: claim returns lease_held; the lead supersedes explicitly; no silent takeover

scenarios.name: pid reused by another process
scenarios.expect: leaseOwnerAlive false; job is interrupted; claim reclaims and bumps the generation

scenarios.name: lease replaced while the old worker is paused
steps: worker-1 wakes and calls commit / heartbeat / fail
scenarios.expect: all three refused with stale_generation; staged output kept under crew/jobs/rejected; no publication

scenarios.name: input digest changed during the sleep
scenarios.expect: commit refuses with input_changed; recovery state becomes stale; the schedule decides what to redo

scenarios.name: approval superseded during the sleep
scenarios.expect: commit refuses with approval_superseded; recovery state waiting-for-approval; the earlier approval record is untouched

never: two directors for one run (diagnose shows drivers > 1 as a problem)
a heartbeat treated as permission to publish
